# Rama DNS security override

Source: published rama-dns 0.3.0-alpha.4, upstream plabayo/rama commit 4733273a10a791762e2b7727850032b0c9b8536d, rama-dns directory. MIT and Apache 2.0 licenses from that exact commit are included. Original manifest is retained as Cargo.toml.orig.

The only dependency change is hickory-resolver 0.25 to 0.26.3 (with matching hickory-proto and hickory-net). Adaptations in src/hickory.rs preserve system DNS, Cloudflare fallback, Google/Quad9 alternatives, configured options, fully qualified domains, typed A/AAAA results and all TXT segments. Hickory 0.26 moves runtime types, replaces named resolver constructors with server groups and returns generic answer records, so explicit record-type filtering replaces typed lookup iteration. System resolver build errors remain fallible and follow the existing fallback path. The custom builder retains its infallible API while preserving any construction error for subsequent lookups to return, avoiding a new panic or silent fallback.

All 18 upstream tests are retained. Four added regressions validate named resolver construction and real loopback UDP DNS for IPv4, IPv6, multi-segment TXT and NXDOMAIN propagation, IDNA domains, binary TXT segments and construction-error propagation. Workspace membership runs these tests in ordinary backend CI. No public DNS requests are needed for the tests. Remove this override after the Codex/Rama stack natively supports patched Hickory.
